title: French Bean Sprouts Tartine
description: A delicious tartine featuring French beans, sprouts, and a hint of yeasty flavor, perfect for a light lunch.
instructions: Slice the French bread into 1-inch thick slices.
Toss the French beans and sprouts with 1 tbsp of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 15 minutes.
Toast the bread slices for 2-3 minutes or until lightly browned.
Spread a layer of yeasty spread on each toasted bread slice.
Top each bread slice with a spoonful of roasted French beans and sprouts, followed by a spoonful of warmed ratatouille.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
